## IRouteMetricsConfig.maxSeries property

Upper bound for the number of distinct label tuples (method, route, status and custom labels) admitted per plugin instance, to keep metric cardinality and memory bounded. Each tuple maps to many histogram and summary series, so this limits tuples, not bytes. Once reached, new tuples are recorded with every label except method and status set to `__overflow__`<!-- -->; tuples admitted earlier keep recording normally. Must be a positive integer.

**Signature:**

```typescript
maxSeries?: number;
```

## Default Value

`undefined` (unlimited)
